shows.title: JFK Assassination / Business of Surveillance
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Mark Shaw joins the show as we mark the November 22, 1963 assassination of President John F. Kennedy and explore why questions surrounding the case endure more than six decades later.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Technology commentator Sarah Westall will discuss surveillance pricing, consumer-data tracking, and how companies profit from personal information. She'll also examine AI's economic impact, the race to build data centers, which jobs are most vulnerable to automation, and what happens when AI replaces the entry-level roles that train future experts.

shows.title: Exploring the Paranormal Unknown / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Guest host Rich Berra (email) welcomes writer, director, and producer Paul Davids to examine his paranormal investigations, evidence for life after death, AI-assisted spirit communication and UFO disclosure. He'll share details from his latest trip to the historic sanctuary of Machu-Picchu.
shows.second_half: Followed by Open Lines. Give Rich a call and discuss whatever's on your mind.
